Name: Item Data Extractor
Author: tbonehunter
Description: This mod is a companion mod to the Custom Starter Package Builder, a GUI configuration tool for adding starter package items to aedenthorn's Custom Starter Package mod. Press F8 from within an existing game to extract item data from a game and save to a JSON file for use with Custom Starter Package Builder. Please note that unless you run this mod inside a game with mod-added items, it will not add anything to the existing CSPB JSON file.

Downloads.Description: Companion app for Custom Starter Package Builder. Extracts item data from the SV game in which it's used, for replacement of the existing vanilla items in CSPB.
